name: Awaiting Reinforcements
description: Skirmishes over newly discovered ruins are not uncommon, as various factions compete to be the first to explore them. Hold out a while longer—reinforcements are on their way!

questRules.label: Stronger Presence
questRules.description:
Stronger Presence is determined by calculating the total Recruitment Points of each party fully within the specified area. Add together the Recruitment Points of all Alive Party Members fully within 7" of the Obelisk (do not include Upgrades).

Compare this total with the other player(s). The player with the highest Recruitment Point total has the Stronger Presence.
